title: Share a private pack safely
description: Explicitly confirm all-file access before sending a private Dub Pack to a friend.

steps.caption: 1. Your Dubs includes private packs that are visible only to you and authorised recipients.
2. Share pack opens the friend picker for this private release.
3. Choose the recipient and explicitly grant access to all current files in the pack.

target.name: Grant selected friends access to all current files in this private pack.

steps.caption: 4. Send pack confirms delivery. The uploader can revoke pack access later in pack management.
